entries.description: Study merge performance for results from various search services.

entries.description: Study retrieval efficiency of genomics data and corresponding documentation.

entries.description: Obtain High Accuracy Retrieval from Documents by leveraging searcher's context.

entries.name: Interactive Track
entries.description: Study user interaction with text retrieval systems.

entries.name: Knowledge base acceleration
entries.description: Study algorithms that improve efficiency of human Knowledge Base.

entries.name: Legal Track
entries.description: Study retrieval systems that have high recall for legal documents use case.

entries.name: Medical Track
entries.description: Explore unstructured search performance over patients record data.

entries.name: Microblog Track
entries.description: Examine satisfaction of real-time information need for microblogging sites.

entries.name: Million Query Track
entries.description: Explore ad-hoc retrieval over large set of queries.

entries.name: Novelty Track
entries.description: Investigate systems' abilities to locate new (non-redundant) information.

entries.name: Question Answering Track
entries.description: Test systems that scale beyond document retrieval, to retrieve answers to factoid, list and definition type questions.

entries.name: Relevance Feedback Track
entries.description: For deep evaluation of relevance feedback processes.

entries.name: Robust Track
entries.description: Study individual topic's effectiveness.

entries.name: Session Track
entries.description: Develop methods for measuring multiple-query sessions where information needs drift.

entries.name: SPAM Track
entries.description: Benchmark spam filtering approaches.

entries.name: Tasks Track
entries.description: Test if systems can induce possible tasks, users might be trying to accomplish for the query.

entries.name: Temporal Summarization Track
entries.description: Develop systems that allow users to efficiently monitor the information associated with an event over time.

entries.name: Terabyte Track
entries.description: Test scalability of IR systems to large scale collection.

entries.name: Web Track
entries.description: Explore information seeking behaviors common in general web search.
